answer: A sybil swarm only wins if minting identities is cheap, so put a compute kernel at the gate: every new identity must burn a real proof-of-work, making a thousand fakes cost a thousand times the electricity of one. Then let rewards mirror only genuine non-kin peer judgment, so clones grading clones cancel to nothing. As the honest tide of diverse attesters rises, a lone attacker's forged crowd stays costly to run yet earns nothing.
